Moreover, positive sinus P waves could be tracked throughout lead II at a relatively stable sinus rate of approximately 90 beats per minute (Figure 2A). These electrocardiographic features were incompatible with atrial fibrillation or atrial tachycardia (P waves < QRS complexes). Double firing over both the fast and slow nodal pathways was suspected during this arrhythmia, presenting as dual atrioventricular nodal nonreentrant tachycardia (DAVNNT).4Occasional block over the slow pathway or fast pathway occurred, observing 1:1 A:V conduction with normal or prolonged PR intervals, respectively.
